description: AlphaFold v6 analysis: CHCH fold, disulfide connectivity and free cysteines in cmc4 vs comparators
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})

def af(acc, v=6):
    r=S.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v{v}.pdb",timeout=120)
    return r.text if r.status_code==200 else None

def parse(pdb):
    rows=[]
    for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
            rows.append(dict(name=ln[12:16].strip(), res=ln[17:20].strip(), resi=int(ln[22:26]),
                             x=float(ln[30:38]),y=float(ln[38:46]),z=float(ln[46:54]),b=float(ln[60:66])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def helix_mask(ca):
    """alpha-helix proxy: CA(i)-CA(i+4) distance ~5.0-6.5 A"""
    P=ca[["x","y","z"]].values.astype(float); n=len(P)
    h=np.zeros(n,bool)
    for i in range(n-4):
        d=np.linalg.norm(P[i]-P[i+4])
        if 4.8<=d<=6.6: h[i:i+5]=True
    return h

summary=[]
models={}
for name,acc in [("Sp_cmc4","G2TRJ8"),("Hs_CMC4_p8MTCP1","P56277"),("Sp_cox17","Q9P7Z7"),
                 ("Sc_Cox17","Q12287"),("Sc_Cmc1","P36064"),("Sc_Cmc2","Q3E7A4"),
                 ("Sc_Cox19","Q3E731"),("Sc_Coa6","Q3E846")]:
    t=af(acc)
    if t is None: print(name,"NO MODEL"); continue
    models[name]=t
    df=parse(t); ca=df[df.name=="CA"].reset_index(drop=True)
    h=helix_mask(ca)
    sg=df[(df.name=="SG")].reset_index(drop=True)
    P=sg[["x","y","z"]].values.astype(float)
    pairs=[]
    for i in range(len(sg)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(sg)):
            d=float(np.linalg.norm(P[i]-P[j]))
            pairs.append((int(sg.resi[i]),int(sg.resi[j]),round(d,2)))
    pairs=sorted(pairs,key=lambda z:z[2])
    ss=[p for p in pairs if p[2]<3.0]
    paired={c for p in ss for c in p[:2]}
    free=sorted(set(sg.resi.astype(int))-paired)
    summary.append(dict(protein=name,acc=acc,L=len(ca),mean_pLDDT=round(ca.b.mean(),1),
                        helix_frac=round(h.mean(),2), nCys=len(sg),
                        SS_bonds=";".join(f"{a}-{b}({d})" for a,b,d in ss), free_Cys=",".join(map(str,free)),
                        closest_nonSS=f"{pairs[len(ss)][0]}-{pairs[len(ss)][1]}:{pairs[len(ss)][2]}A" if len(pairs)>len(ss) else "-"))
sm=pd.DataFrame(summary); pd.set_option("display.width",300)
print(sm.to_string(index=False))
globals()['MODELS']=models

# --- detailed cmc4 ---
df=parse(models["Sp_cmc4"]); ca=df[df.name=="CA"].reset_index(drop=True)
seq3to1=dict(ALA="A",ARG="R",ASN="N",ASP="D",CYS="C",GLN="Q",GLU="E",GLY="G",HIS="H",ILE="I",
             LEU="L",LYS="K",MET="M",PHE="F",PRO="P",SER="S",THR="T",TRP="W",TYR="Y",VAL="V")
h=helix_mask(ca)
segs=[];cur=None
for i,v in enumerate(h):
    if v and cur is None: cur=i
    if not v and cur is not None: segs.append((cur+1,i)); cur=None
if cur is not None: segs.append((cur+1,len(h)))
print("\nSp_cmc4 AlphaFold helical segments (CA i,i+4 criterion):",segs)
print("Sp_cmc4 pLDDT by residue:")
print(" ".join(f"{seq3to1[r.res]}{r.resi}:{r.b:.0f}" for r in ca.itertuples()))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.2))
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(ca.resi,ca.b,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.8)
for s,e in segs: ax.axvspan(s,e,color="#2b6cb0",alpha=0.12)
for c in [4,9,14,25,35,36,54]:
    ax.axvline(c,color="#c05621",ls="--",lw=0.9)
    ax.text(c,101,f"C{c}",rotation=90,fontsize=7,color="#c05621",va="bottom",ha="center")
ax.set_ylim(0,115); ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_title("S. pombe cmc4 AlphaFold confidence\n(shaded = helical, dashed = Cys)",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
sg=df[df.name=="SG"].reset_index(drop=True); P=sg[["x","y","z"]].values.astype(float)
n=len(sg); D=np.zeros((n,n))
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n): D[i,j]=np.linalg.norm(P[i]-P[j])
im=ax.imshow(D,cmap="viridis_r"); lab=[f"C{int(r)}" for r in sg.resi]
ax.set_xticks(range(n)); ax.set_xticklabels(lab); ax.set_yticks(range(n)); ax.set_yticklabels(lab)
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        ax.text(j,i,f"{D[i,j]:.1f}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7,
                color="white" if D[i,j]<8 else "black")
ax.set_title("cmc4 Cys SG-SG distances (A)\nvalues < 3 A = disulfide",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,label="SG-SG distance (A)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
